subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should OpenClaw accept explicitly configured custom-basename bootstrap files as a core hook contract, or keep bootstrap-extra-files limited to recognized workspace filenames?
rationale: This changes deterministic session startup context and the hook file-loading contract, which AGENTS.md treats as config/session-state sensitive rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve Repaired Hook Contract
options.body: Allow custom-basename files through the existing hook path after the linked PR or a replacement is rebased and preserves path guards, budgets, and session filtering.

options.title: Keep Recognized Basenames Only
options.body: Reject arbitrary workspace-file injection and route users to existing AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md composition or narrower first-class filename proposals.

options.title: Defer To Broader Context API
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers design a more general context-file or session-context contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Repaired Hook Contract
recommendation.body: Allow custom-basename files through the existing hook path after the linked PR or a replacement is rebased and preserves path guards, budgets, and session filtering.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original bootstrap hook feature and has adjacent bootstrap/docs ownership history.
